skill.name: github-gem-seeker
skill.description: Search GitHub for battle-tested solutions instead of reinventing the wheel. Use when the user's problem is universal enough that open source developers have probably solved it already—especially for: format conversion (video/audio/image/document), media downloading, file manipulation, web scraping/archiving, automation scripts, and CLI tools. Prefer this skill over writing custom code for well-trodden problems.
skill.userDescription: Search GitHub for battle-tested open-source solutions and CLI tools instead of reinventing the wheel for common technical tasks.
exampleQuestions: Find a popular open-source command-line tool to batch convert WebP images to PNG.
Search GitHub for an efficient repository that downloads public YouTube video transcripts.
Look up a reliable Python utility on GitHub for parsing and extracting data from large PDF files.
